title: Group Fishing from Boat on Lake, 1920s Elko Border Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful 1920s snapshot featuring two men and two women relaxing on a small wooden boat equipped with an outboard motor on a calm body of water. Two of the women hold fishing rods, while everyone smiles warmly toward the camera. The print is framed by a distinctive decorative 'ELKO' photo-finishing Greek key border, typical of commercial amateur darkroom processing from the late 1920s and early 1930s.
